topFAQs: What is the pricing for a website?
How much time does it take to deliver?
Do you provide DLT OTP infrastructure for login?

learnedInsights.insight: Visitors frequently ask if hosting is included. AI should proactively highlight 1-Year Free High-Speed Cloud VPS & Free Domain with every project package.
Visitors appreciate instant, transparent ₹ INR price estimations with clear feature breakdown (e.g. ₹15,000 for standard business sites, ₹25,000 for dynamic apps).
Prospects want to know turnaround times. Highlight rapid delivery sprints (7 to 14 days full production deployment).
Visitors in India respond best to polite, warm, and helpful Hinglish / Hindi assistance with quick WhatsApp quotation connect.
